cases.case: a put of a new name is created
the same put again is the same (a lost answer, replayed)
other bytes at that name conflict, naming the stored checksum
a get streams the whole object, its checksum checked
a ranged get answers exactly the range
a range past the end answers the tail
a range starting past the end is refused
cases.detail: Err(Refused { status: 416, detail: "the range starts past the end" })

cases.case: an absent name reads as absent
an absent name streams as absent
a put into another life's epoch is refused
cases.detail: Err(Refused { status: 403, detail: "a put names another life's epoch" })

cases.case: the same head again is the same (a lost answer, replayed)
a later checkpoint of this life is taken
the same checkpoint with another body is refused
cases.detail: Err(Refused { status: 409, detail: "the same checkpoint with another body" })

cases.case: the same checkpoint marked clean (a sleep) is taken
a clean head never loses its mark
cases.detail: Err(Refused { status: 409, detail: "a clean head loses its mark" })

cases.detail: Err(Refused { status: 409, detail: "only the running life posts a head" })
